corroboration: 18 paper what-if previews across 9 strikes and both rights put a SINGLE short MBT option at 3441.42 to 4599.07 USD, median 3930.96, zero of 18 below the ceiling. That is 2.0x to 2.7x this future figure, consistent with a broker markup rather than a simulator artifact.
independent_corroboration: Schwab reported MBT initial margin near 2800 USD as of 2026-03-24 alongside 140000 for full-size BTC (5 bitcoin), implying ~20% of notional and bitcoin near 140000 in March. The same ~20% rule at today's 81777.50 gives ~1700. Two independent sources agree on the PERCENTAGE, stronger than either figure alone.
measured_is: CME exchange-minimum MAINTENANCE margin on ONE MBT future, front month 09/2026
measured_is_a_floor_because: It is the hedge leg ALONE. The two short option legs are additional.
It is maintenance, not initial. Customer initial conventionally runs about 1.1x.
It is the exchange minimum. IBKR applies its own multiplier above it.
measured_notional_source: MBT front future touch 81770.0/81785.0, paper session 2026-09-03, reports/task1/probe_session.json
verdict_sentence: The delta-hedging future alone, at the exchange minimum, requires 20.84% of notional against a registered ceiling of 12.80%. The gate FAILS by 1.628x on the cheapest single component of the position.
why_notional_normalized: A dollar ceiling moves with the bitcoin price; a fraction of notional does not. Normalizing makes the verdict robust to a price move rather than hostage to one.
